name: First sign-in completes the BidWatch introduction before the workspace
description: Verifies a provisioned user receives a concise first-use introduction, can complete it, and can then use the normal bid workflow.
steps: Sign in with the provisioned Google account for a user who has not completed onboarding
Review the three-step BidWatch introduction
Choose Start using BidWatch on the final step
Open Add bid and create a valid bid titled "Network Security RFP"
Refresh BidWatch
expected: The onboarding dialog is shown only before completion, the user reaches the Dashboard, the bid persists, and the introduction does not reappear after refresh.

name: Dashboard deadline cards remain readable at mobile width
description: Verifies the Dashboard remains readable for users who need larger text and narrow screens.
steps: Sign in as a role that can see personal and team deadline summaries
Open Dashboard at 375x667
Review My deadlines and Unassigned bids cards
Increase browser text size or zoom and review the same cards
expected: Card text has visible spacing from borders, remains readable without clipping, and the cards reflow without losing their labels or actions.

name: Destructive deletion preserves a text-only bid history record
description: Verifies an irreversible bid deletion requires explicit confirmation and preserves the bid metadata after stored documents are removed.
setup: Create a bid titled "Historical RFP" with organisation "Example Org" and a small PDF attachment
steps: Open the bid
Choose Delete bid and documents
Review the impact message and choose Keep it
Choose Delete bid and documents again
Choose Delete bid in the confirmation dialog
Open Bid History
expected: The bid disappears from active bids, its stored document is removed, and a text-only history record remains with the bid title, organisation, deadline, status and deletion date.

name: Protected actions cannot be reached through ordinary editing
description: Verifies ordinary editing cannot be used to mark a bid Applied or Declined and non-Super-Admin role managers cannot grant sensitive access-control permissions.
steps: Sign in as a role without bids.apply or bids.decline and open an open bid
Attempt to change the bid to Applied or Declined through the normal edit flow
Sign in as a non-Super-Admin role manager and attempt to create or edit a role containing users.manage, roles.manage, or settings.manage
expected: The protected workflow transitions and sensitive permission allocation are unavailable or rejected by the backend, while ordinary bid editing remains separate from those privileges.

name: Production errors remain actionable without exposing internals
description: Verifies a simulated server failure is surfaced as a concise user-facing error rather than a blank screen or technical stack trace.
steps: Open Add bid
Enter a valid bid
Submit while the server returns the simulated 500 response
expected: The UI shows a plain-language failure message and does not display the injected stack trace or internal implementation details.
